question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dune, Bob gets Siddhartha, Claire gets Jane Eyre, Dave gets Persuasion, and Eve gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Alice swap books. Then, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Claire and Alice swap books. Then, Eve and Bob swap books. Finally, Alice and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Eve has
Options:
(A) Dune
(B) Siddhartha
(C) Jane Eyre
(D) Persuasion
(E) Ivanhoe
solution:
Each row lists the books in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: Dune | Siddhartha | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Ivanhoe
1. Bob–Alice: Siddhartha | Dune | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Ivanhoe
2. Bob–Claire: Siddhartha | Jane Eyre | Dune | Persuasion | Ivanhoe
3. Claire–Alice: Dune | Jane Eyre | Siddhartha | Persuasion | Ivanhoe
4. Eve–Bob: Dune | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
5. Alice–Bob: Ivanhoe | Dune | Siddhartha | Persuasion | Jane Eyre
Eve has Jane Eyre, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
